_about: Every place the mod touches Slap City. Each row is one Harmony patch or plugin system; its code carries the marker // Hook:<id> so preflight can check it exists.

rows.does: adds each champion as a hidden skin (lol_<name>) of its base fighter before the skin list is built
a champion skin loads and uses the base fighter's default skin asset
adds a row of six champion slots with League icons to the character select grid
a champion slot (base#lol_id) picks the base fighter with the champion skin; other slots clear it
player box shows the champion's League loading-screen art and plays its pick voice line
a fighter spawned with a champion skin gets the League model attached and its own meshes hidden
reads the base fighter's playing clip each frame and plays the mapped League animation on the champion skeleton
plays the ability's League sfx and voice line, applies cast effects (dash, shield, heal_cast)
every champion hit gets its passive and buffs; a special-move hit also gets the ability's multipliers and effects; shields, Flow, parries and Wind Wall act on hits taken
a hit on a parrying champion, or a projectile into Wind Wall, is not registered at all
one case per effects row: what each hit, cast and passive changes
bleeds, burns, slows, stuns and echoes on any fighter, applied through Slap City's own damage and speed bonuses each frame

rows.target: LeagueObjects (tornado, wind wall, barrels, Yone's spirit)
rows.does: spawns the objects sheet's things with League meshes and textures, moves them, and lets them hit, block or snap back
an object's hit is delivered as a Slap City hurt message, so knockback, hitstun, DI and the HUD work as for any hit
restores the hitbox properties changed by hit-effects and applies heals
plays the champion's knockout voice line once per KO
finds the League install from SLAPRIFT_LEAGUE (set by Melty) or the Riot Client's install record and reads champion files in place
decodes the champion's Wwise audio from the player's install with the bundled vgmstream into a local cache and loads it as AudioClips
during a Melty test run, starts a local match with champions and reports checks
